title: Kono Fukushuu ni Gal wa Iranai
titleRomaji: Kono Fukushuu ni Gal wa Iranai
titleNative: この復讐にギャルはいらない
synopsis: Nozomi Kashihara's parents were killed when he was young, and he has lived a life as an assassin without knowing any human warmth. Betraying the "family" that raised him, he now spends his days as a serious high school student without any friends. But when he helped Shingu-san, a gal in his class, from some delinquents, they begin to form a relationship. But Kashihara can't help but suspect that she might be an assassin targeting him...? (Source: Young Animal Comics, translated)

title: Kaisou Toshi Danpenshuu
titleNative: 階層都市断片集
synopsis: In a world approaching its end, humanity has built a colossal, multi-layered city that rises high into the sky through the power of advanced technology. As the city continues to expand, its inhabitants live their lives within and around the vast structure, creating new connections and leaving behind the fruits of human endeavor. Spanning different eras in this dying world, the story presents a series of snapshots that capture the lives, hopes, and everyday experiences of the people who inhabit the towering metropolis—a record of humanity and the traces it leaves behind. (Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Aoku Somero
titleNative: 蒼く染めろ
synonyms: Dye Blue, Even If You Die
synopsis: The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? Or perhaps a prestigious club in England? The entire country was watching with anticipation to see where he would go. But the young prodigy made a surprising choice: he decided to attend “a Japanese high school where his underachieving younger brother would be enrolling.” “Because there’s someone amazing there that I want to play with!” With the “genius older brother” and the “underachieving younger brother,” let them stir up a storm in the world of soccer! In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)
